[USER] The user inquired about how the priming effect is implemented in the human brain.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The exact mechanisms of priming are not well understood, with different researchers proposing various theories.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Most theories of priming suggest that exposure to certain stimuli activates related concepts or associations in the brain, influencing responses to subsequent stimuli.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] One explanation for priming involves changes in the strength of connections between different neurons in the brain.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Increased activity of certain neurons due to exposure to a stimulus may strengthen connections with other neurons, influencing responses to subsequent stimuli.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Another possibility is that priming involves changes in neurotransmitter levels, such as dopamine, which could influence neuron activity and processing of subsequent stimuli.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] More research is needed to fully understand the underlying mechanisms of priming.
